name_reason: Global holds a malloc'd pointer to the currently-loaded chapter's FDTXT.DAT text bank (loaded as resource chapter_id+1). Convention requires the name to reflect the data type; sibling pointer globals in the same region carry a _ptr suffix when the descriptor is a plain content noun (data_fd2_battle_tile_map_ptr, data_fd2_tile_event_data_table_ptr, data_fd2_tile_attribute_flags_buffer_ptr), and the direct sibling data_fd2_all_game_text_ptr (the engine-wide FDTXT bank, 0x53A7D) already uses _ptr. Adding _ptr makes 'text' (a content noun like 'tile_map'/'table') consistent with these. Not address residue, not a correctness fix -- a data-type-consistency rename. Apply in Stage 2 (touches globals.h + ~110 call sites).
purpose: Base pointer to the currently-loaded chapter's FDTXT.DAT text bank (resource index = chapter_id+1); the per-chapter dialog/text source consumed by fd2_display_dialog_scene.
logic_summary: Written by fd2_load_chapter_battle_data (0x1088d) and fd2_load_save_and_init_engine (0x101e3) via fd2_load_dat_resource("FDTXT.DAT"=0x51a43, prior_value, chapter_id+1) -- the prior value is passed in so the loader frees-then-reloads. Read by ~110 sites (all chapter NN init/end handlers, chapter post_action handlers, chapter event handlers, btl_turn, dialog) which pass it as the text_base (1st) argument of fd2_display_dialog_scene(0x15f84) together with a line/page index into the text blob. Distinct from data_fd2_all_game_text_ptr (0x53A7D), the engine-wide non-chapter text bank (resource 0).
datatype: uint32 (4-byte pointer slot; void* to heap-allocated FDTXT chapter text resource)
element_semantics: Single scalar pointer slot. Holds the malloc'd base address of the decoded FDTXT.DAT[chapter_id+1] resource (a page-index header table followed by an int16 dialog-opcode/text stream). Reloaded on each chapter change / save load; the loader frees the previous allocation referenced by the passed-in prior value.
notes: Memory at 0x53A79 reads all zero (BSS zero-init), consistent with a runtime-populated pointer slot. No Ghidra function/data plate exists at this address (get_plate_comment -> 'No function at address'); src comment block (main.c:1094-1099) is the authoritative doc and is accurate+concise, so no plate created. src comment left unchanged (keep). No logic touched. Note: data_fd2_chapter_portrait_load_buffer @ 0x53A59 also lacks a _ptr suffix despite being a pointer (out of scope here).
